summary: Return generic errors with a correlation id
description: SEC-04 and SEC-29. Developer-facing errors come from a fixed set. An unexpected exception becomes a generic 500. The body has a correlation id and no stack trace.
scope: A raised RuntimeError becomes the generic 500 body
The correlation id is in the body and the header
acceptanceCriteria: A route that raises RuntimeError('secret-path') returns status 500, code server_error, and message The service could not complete this request. The body does not contain Traceback, RuntimeError, or secret-path. Header X-Correlation-Id equals the body's correlation_id. SEC-04 SEC-29.
constraints: Do not include the exception text in the response.
Do not omit the correlation id.
Do not return a stack trace.
